entries.name: architecture-diagrammer
entries.description: Generates system architecture, Entity-Relationship, and Sequence diagrams from a Product Requirements Document (PRD).

entries.name: brand-identity-architect
entries.description: Generates a comprehensive brand strategy (voice, positioning, messaging) for clients who lack a brand identity (inspired by arnabbagxd Brand-building-skills).

entries.name: business-model-analyst
entries.description: Pressure-tests your own product idea from a business and commercial viability perspective before committing to building it.

entries.name: client-intake-parser
entries.description: Extracts client requirements from raw meeting transcripts or emails and populates the formal Intake Questionnaire.

entries.name: client-update-generator
entries.description: Translates technical git commits and task completions into a polished, non-technical weekly update email for the client.

entries.name: continuous-learner
entries.description: Analyzes recently solved problems, bug fixes, or architecture decisions and updates the agency's skills and templates so future projects automatically get smarter.

entries.name: crash-debugger
entries.description: Reads production error logs and stack traces to automatically diagnose the root cause and suggest the exact code fix.

entries.name: devils-advocate-critic
entries.description: Adversarial cross-checking skill that stress-tests and attacks code, architectures, PRDs, and contracts to uncover hidden flaws, race conditions, security vulnerabilities, and scope risks.

entries.name: domain-agent-architect
entries.description: Conducts a /grill-me one-question-at-a-time Socratic discovery interview (after scanning any Intake/PRD docs) to identify a project's domain nature and permanently materialize native project-specific domain specialist agents, Antigravity 2.0 rules, skills, Laya routing, and 7-Phase critic gates.

entries.name: legacy-project-onboarder
entries.description: Reverse-engineers an existing or mid-flight codebase to automatically generate the missing agency documentation (PRD, Architecture, Runbooks).

entries.name: legal-risk-flagging
entries.description: Audits generated contracts (MSA, SLA, SOW) to flag liabilities or over-promises before presenting to the client.

entries.name: prd-discovery-agent
entries.description: Transforms vague client ideas or rough personal product concepts into a complete, detailed PRD through a structured Socratic interview with the AI.

entries.name: proposal-pricing-calculator
entries.description: Generates a scoped Statement of Work and calculates estimated pricing based on feature breakdown.

entries.name: repowise-codebase-mapper
entries.description: Uses the RepoWise tool to index and map massive legacy codebases so AI agents can understand them without blowing up their context window.

entries.name: ripwire-laya-intelligence
entries.description: Layer 0 (Ripwire v0.6.5 structural & doc-graph recall, lane planning, merge-scout, quality-delta) and Layer 1 (Laya System-1 typed task routing, rubric scoring, and scope-creep classification) intelligence skill.

entries.name: senior-designer-ui
entries.description: A persona-based skill that forces the coding agent to apply high-end, premium UI/UX principles (inspired by Owl-Listener designer skills) instead of default "developer design".

entries.name: session-resumer
entries.description: Instantly reads the active project state and deliverables to catch up a fresh AI chat on where the project left off and identify the exact next action.

entries.name: skillui-generator
entries.description: Uses the open-source SkillUI tool to reverse-engineer a target website's design system into a usable skill file for your agents.

entries.name: strix-security-auditor
entries.description: Orchestrates the Strix open-source AI penetration testing tool to automatically find and remediate vulnerabilities in the codebase before deployment.

entries.name: tech-stack-adviser
entries.description: Adversarial trade-off evaluation skill that rigorously debates, challenges, and justifies technology stack selections (Frameworks, Databases, Auth, Hosting) across Velocity, Cost, Complexity, and Scalability.

entries.name: wcag-accessibility-auditor
entries.description: Audits web applications for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, keyboard navigation, color contrast, and ARIA screen reader attributes.
